caption: The drawing depicts an ornate, densely packed floral pattern consisting of various large flowers and curling leaves. The color palette includes shades of green, yellow, brown, beige, and gray, providing a naturalistic effect. The leaves are colored in different tones of green with some yellowish and brownish hues, while the flowers have petals in muted yellows, grays, and off-whites, with detailed line work in brown, gray, and green emphasizing the petals and centers. The background space between the leaves and flowers is filled with additional smaller foliage and curved lines, giving the composition a rich, layered appearance. Along the right edge and bottom of the pattern, there is a scalloped border outlined in black and filled with brown and black semi-circular shapes, resembling a lace or textile trim. The overall composition is square, with the floral pattern extending to the boundaries and partially cut off at the edges. The drawing is rendered on a light beige paper.
title: Chintz Square
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
